name: Play-first: sofa toward the stairs, soft ottoman, the biggest play floor by the BESTÅ drawers
notes:
Alternative, play-first: the living group moves 21" toward the stairs and loses its hard corners: the soft KIVIK ottoman stands in for the coffee table, a low PERJOHAN bench backs the sofa, and the KALLAX TV unit's cubbies hold toy boxes. The right half of the room is one big play floor on a 67 x 94" sage STOENSE, with BESTÅ toy drawers in the niche, a SMÅSTAD reading bench and a KALLAX 2x2 of toy drawers on the upper section, the LÄTT table, and Maddie's POÄNG with the FLISAT book display.
sofa-1 KIVIK, x 84-173.75, y 47.5-84.875: back 41.5" from the heater face (F-33); screen 103.9" from the back-cushion line (F-37: 1.60x, the far end of the range: the sofa sits as far back as the rule allows to open the floor in front); delivery-path-unmeasured (F-22).
bench-1 PERJOHAN bench with storage, x 109.188-148.562, y 36.5-47.5, against the sofa's back, 17 3/4" tall: books and two GNABBAS baskets on the window side; 30.5" route behind it along the window (F-39, 30" needed).
ottoman-1 KIVIK ottoman with storage, x 111.188-146.562, y 98.875-126.375: 14" in front of the sofa (F-39), 31.2" from the TV unit (F-30); soft, no corners, machine-washable cover; drinks go on the side table or a tray.
tv-stand-2 KALLAX TV unit, white stained oak effect, bottom wall x 100-157.75: four DRÖNA toy boxes in its four KALLAX-size lower cubbies, 24" clear in front (F-32); its page says to fix it to the wall; tv-1 Samsung 65" on it, 2" from the wall (31.7 lb on a 35 lb limit: within it, 3.3 lb to spare).
side-table-1 LACK side table with lamp-1 STORSEGEL, x 174.75-196.375, y 50-71.625, at the right arm; floor-lamp-2 TÅGARP at the left arm (x 74-83, y 50-59), 2" past the stair strip: the living group now uses the floor by the stairs.
rug-1 TIOKRONA 118 x 94", x 72-190, y 72-166: under the sofa's front, the ottoman and the open floor to the TV; plant-1 FEJKA behind the sofa's right end.
rug-4 STOENSE 67 x 94" pale green, x 192-259, y 70-164: the play floor, continuous with the open floor in front of the sofa.
sideboard-1 BESTÅ storage combination with drawers, the 77" right-lower niche y 96.062-166.938, x 259-275.5: toy drawers and doors (F-63, F-61); anchor-required (F-21, 29 1/8"); 24" clear in front (F-32). art-1 PJÄTTERYD Waterlilies above it.
toy-bench-1 SMÅSTAD reading bench in the window corner, right-upper wall y 18-53.375: 12" from the heater face (F-33); its boxes keep 24" (F-32); wall-lamp-1 UPPLYST above it and the LÖVA canopy over it (an extra, 12"+ off the heater face); art-2 RÖDALM on the window wall beside it. Check the heater's surface temperature before she reads there.
bookcase-2 KALLAX 2x2 with four KALLAX drawer inserts (eight toy drawers), right-upper wall y 62.875-93: anchor-required (F-21, 30 1/8"); 24" clear in front (F-32).
kids-table-1 LÄTT with its two chairs, x 205-229.75, y 100-118.875: 29.2" from the BESTÅ fronts and below the KALLAX's 24" (F-32).
kid-chair-1 POÄNG kid's armchair against the far wall, x 196-214.5, y 151-173, facing the play floor; book-display-1 FLISAT beside it (x 215.5-234.75, y 162-173), 24.2" left of the BESTÅ's drawer zone.
shoe-cabinet-1 BISSA, bottom wall x 76-95.25: anchor-required (F-21); 12" for its tilt-out; hooks-1 HÖVOLM at coat height and hooks-2 FLISAT at Maddie's height above it; mirror-1 LILJETRÄD by the top landing.
Free wall: the bottom wall x 157.75-196 (38.2") stays clear and reachable by a 30" path (assumed-position:door); the play corner fills the rest.
Right side (F-61): the 77" right-lower wall carries the BESTÅ (70 7/8"), the 93" right-upper wall the SMÅSTAD and the KALLAX 2x2 (65 1/2" of 81").
Not placed: the LACK coffee table and console (the ottoman and the PERJOHAN replace them), the chaise sofa and IDANÄS (c), the BESTÅ TV unit (a, b), TROFAST (a, b), KALLAX 2x4 (c), LEN and VALLABY rugs (a, b, c), the grown-up POÄNG (the ottoman is the extra seat), LAUTERS.
Stairs: nothing on the x 0-36 band (F-40, assumed-position:stairs); both 36" landings stay clear, and the 36" strip beside the band (x 36-72) is kept as a walkway joining them, so each landing meets the open floor with at least 30" (F-30). Nothing she can climb stands against the stair side, whose edge (wall, half wall or railing) is unknown.
Heater: every clearance is measured from the drawn 6" heater face (heater-depth-assumed): floor pieces start at y 12 or more and upholstery at y 18 or more (F-33). Window: its place on the top wall is eyeballed (assumed-position:window); curtains and rod hang there and nothing stands under it (F-38).
Kid safety (F-21): no glass anywhere; every TV unit is fixed to the wall as its page says, and the TV gets an anti-tip strap; tall storage is anchored.
Extras: GINSTMOTT curtains x2 pairs, HUGAD rod x1 (no-dimensions, an extra), SVARTPOPPEL covers x2, VALLKRASSING covers x2, FJÄDRAR inserts x4, VALLKRASSING throw x1, KALLAX insert with 2 drawers x4, DRÖNA boxes x4 (TV unit cubbies), GNABBAS baskets x2 (PERJOHAN shelf), LÖVA canopy x1.
